body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #3, company drawn at random from the cheapest EV/EBITDA tercile (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.58 (naive base rate 0.5) that: Automotive Axles FY27 net profit is >= Rs 220 cr. Our reasoning: H1 FY27 Rs 105.7 cr; H2 needs Rs 114.3 cr vs the Q2 run-rate of Rs 120 cr per half; the Rs 12 cr labour-code exceptional of Q3 FY26 does not repeat. Naive base: 5 of 10 fiscal years FY17-FY26 had PAT growth >= 34% (FY17, FY18, FY19, FY22, FY23) [SCR]. Resolution: YES if profit for the year FY27, as first reported in the audited FY27 results, is >= Rs 220 cr. Source: NSE integrated-filing XBRL (FY27 results). Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
